description: This file is a type declaration for the 'node:domain' module, providing type information for the Domain class and related functions, with a focus on error handling and event management within domains. It includes deprecated notes and documentation comments for the class and methods.

classes.name: Domain
classes.description: Encapsulates domain-related error routing and exception handling, inheriting from EventEmitter, with methods to run functions within a domain context, add or remove emitters, and bind or intercept callbacks for error handling.

methods.name: enter(): void; enter
methods.description: Sets the current domain as active, managing the domain stack for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: exit
methods.description: Exits the current domain, removing it from the domain stack.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a function within the domain context, binding all asynchronous operations created during its execution.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Explicitly adds an EventEmitter to the domain for error handling.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an emitter from domain error handling.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Wraps a callback to route its errors to the domain’s error event.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Wraps a callback to route thrown errors and error objects passed as first argument to the domain’s error event.
